violations.description: Other reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.
violations.reason: The agent modified reservation 43TOIE by calling update_reservation_flights with flight HAT015, which changed the reservation's destination from LGA to EWR. The existing reservation details at step 7 show the current flight HAT087 is CLT to LGA, and the user requested CLT to EWR at step 2. This destination change violates the policy prohibition on modifying reservations while changing the destination, and the agent was required to verify this rule before calling the API.
